frame: Twin frame (twin/data/frame.json): metres, +x campus east along Teaching Block 1, +y campus north towards the North Gate, +z up; z = 0 at the forecourt road in front of Teaching Block 1.

evidence.esri: assets/cinematic/aligned/courtyard.jpg read through twin/tools/ortho.py (0.55 m/px). Ground-level edges are read directly; anything with height leans by (-0.335, +0.53) m per metre of height in twin x/y.
evidence.osm: OpenStreetMap via Overture 2026-11-18.0: campus boundary, axis road and the street centreline north of the gate, artwork polygon of the rock.
evidence.photos: jiaoxuelou-1600 (plinth, inscription, red granite steps, porch), campus_taihushi (rock from the north), hero-2560 (axis from the North Gate), scenery_13 (side plaza under the Terminalia canopy), aerial_campus (paving pattern, lawns).

levels.basis: Four 0.15 m risers between the forecourt road and the plaza and three between the plaza and the porch counted on jiaoxuelou-1600; three to four risers from the side plazas down to the lawns (lanshu-1600, aerial_campus); kerbs assumed 0.15 m. No levelling survey.

zones.basis: light paved apron between the gate and the street on the Esri layer (x -7..+5); width widened to the gate piers; flush with the road (assumed)
OSM centreline of the street north of the gate; 10 m carriageway and 3.5 m footways assumed
light footpath round the two lawn blocks (north edge y 40.5..42.6, east edge x 63.5..66 down to y 15) on the Esri layer; the west branch is hidden under canopy and mirrored (invented)
light strip north of the parked cars (y 51.9..54.6 read, kept narrower)
lawn block east of the plaza: inner edge x 12.3..12.5, north edge y 40.0..40.5, rounded corners (kerb curve r ~2.5 m) on the Esri layer; open lawn on aerial_campus; level with the footpaths
lawn block west of the plaza, mirrored where hidden under the west canopy
dark carriageway y 42.6..47.4 plus a parallel-parking lane on the north side (cars 5.5 x 2.4 m at y 47.4..50.0) on the Esri layer

kerb-to-kerb width about 13 m read on hero-2560 at y ~80 (scale checked on the 25 m apron at the far end); the Esri layer shows only the 8 m strip between overhanging canopies; 12 m adopted; OSM centreline on x = 0
paved entry inside the gate, gate width from hero-2560 (14.3 m between the outer piers)
dark apron between the lawn blocks from the road down to the plaza steps (plaza edge y 29.8) on the Esri layer
paving along the east wing under the Terminalia canopy (scenery_13); extent hidden on the Esri layer
mirrored from the east side; the west side is hidden under canopy and roof lean

dark paving with light squares east of the plaza, from the building to y ~21 and east to x ~50-55 (aerial_campus through a 4-point homography, edge distortion uncorrected; Esri patch x 15..24, y 16..20); pattern from scenery_13 and lanshu-1600
dark paving with light squares west of the plaza to x ~-30..-36 (aerial_campus homography; Esri patch x -24..-15, y 16..20)
light plaza x +/-12.5 for y 20..29.8 and x +/-14.7 for y 13..20 on the Esri layer (south of y 13 hidden by the roof lean, assumed to run to the building); dot grid from aerial_campus
planting bed with ground cover and set stones round the trunk, flush-to-low edge (lanshu-1600, aerial_campus dark blob at (27..31, 14)); outline estimated

hedges.basis: low clipped hedge in a planter along the east colonnade (scenery_13, aerial_campus)
hedge along the west colonnade (jiaoxuelou-1600, aerial_campus)

taihu.basis: dark granite plinth with a lawn bed, its north face level with the foot of the steps and its east end against them (jiaoxuelou-1600); width from the step runs; depth from the rock's footprint on the Esri layer (dark mass y 26.3..29.5 including the northward lean of its top). OSM puts the artwork 4-5 m further south (y 20.3..24.5).
taihu.inscription_basis: text read on jiaoxuelou-1600 (running-script calligraphy, 8 characters, signed); typeface substituted. The second panel (alumni donation, 2012) is modelled blank.
taihu.rock_basis: overall size and silhouette (about 7.6 x 3 x 2.9 m; tall perforated east end standing on legs, long low west end with a raised head) from jiaoxuelou-1600 and campus_taihushi; individual holes and crags are procedural (seeded) and not the real ones

yihao.basis: origin = portal centre on the central front wall; ground floor 1.05 m above the forecourt road

open_questions: No levelling survey: every level in 'levels' is counted from risers or assumed.

The Esri layer shows continuous canopy over the east lawn while aerial_campus shows open lawn with one small tree; the photographs are of different (unknown) dates. The Terminalia crown is modelled from the photographs (trunk, limb, boulder) with its extent limited to what both sources allow.
Axis road width: about 13 m kerb to kerb on hero-2560 against an 8 m visible strip on the Esri layer.
The street north of the gate: width and level relative to the campus are assumed.
Rock plinth depth and the rock's exact position along the axis rest on one ortho reading (+/- 1.5 m); OSM differs by 4-5 m.

steps.basis: four red granite risers either side of the rock plinth (jiaoxuelou-1600, aerial_campus); tread assumed
steps down from the side plaza in the foreground of lanshu-1600; light strip along the side plaza's north edge on aerial_campus; full-length flight assumed
